preconditions.description: Input integers n and m must be within the range 1 to 100 inclusive.
The input must consist of exactly two integers n and m separated by whitespace.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly n lines.

postconditions.expression: all(len(line) == int(m) for line in stdout.strip().splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each line in the output must contain exactly m characters.

postconditions.expression: all(c in 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ' for line in stdout.strip().splitlines() for c in line)
postconditions.description: Each cell in the output must be painted with an uppercase Latin letter.

postconditions.expression: all(len(set(line)) == 1 or all(line[i] == line[i+1] for i in range(len(line)-1)) for line in stdout.strip().splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each row must be either a single color or a sequence of adjacent squares of the same color.

postconditions.expression: all(len(set([line[i] for line in stdout.strip().splitlines()])) == 1 or all(stdout.strip().splitlines()[i][j] == stdout.strip().splitlines()[i+1][j] for i in range(int(n)-1)) for j in range(int(m)))
postconditions.description: Each column must be either a single color or a sequence of adjacent squares of the same color.

postconditions.expression: all(len(set([line[i] for line in stdout.strip().splitlines() if line[i] == c])) == 1 or all(stdout.strip().splitlines()[k][l] == c and (k == 0 or stdout.strip().splitlines()[k-1][l] != c) and (l == 0 or stdout.strip().splitlines()[k][l-1] != c) for k in range(int(n)) for l in range(int(m)) if line[i] == c) for c in set(''.join(stdout.strip().splitlines())))
postconditions.description: Each connected region of the same color must form a square.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout.strip().splitlines()[i][j] <= stdout.strip().splitlines()[k][l] for i in range(int(n)) for j in range(int(m)) for k in range(int(n)) for l in range(int(m)) if (i < k) or (i == k and j < l))
postconditions.description: The coloring must be lexicographically minimal.
